summary: All five round-3 defects confirmed and fixed; VM gate green, assigned corpus categories at zero, unrelated failures unchanged.
body:
Changed this round:

- [import.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs): audio eligibility and source timing independent of visual classification; repeat-template audio suppression and reporting.
- [overlay.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs): builtin dependency table, complete expression text scanning, ancestor behavior retention, regression tests.
- [import/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs): audio timing and round-trip regressions.

Earlier fixes and sr_core_corpus.rs changes remain intact, including the coordinator’s SAMPLE_REGRESSION. No ignores were added.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import(bytes: &[u8], opts: &ImportOptions)
    -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;
```

All five findings were accepted; none rejected:

1. **Repeat audio:** raw descendants are templates, whereas the renderer mixes expanded occurrences. The resolver does not expose those occurrences, so their soundtracks are now omitted with an explicit Report entry, as authorized. This prevents phantom audio for count=0 and misleading single-copy audio for count=2. Sources: XSD repeatType; sr-eval/src/program.rs::repeat; sr-deliver/src/audio.rs.
2. **3D audio:** eligibility now follows the media asset. A single additional bounded resolver pass neutralizes layer threeD attributes for source-timing resolution while retaining the original overlay document. Tests cover container clocks, trims, reverse loops, remapping, and export/re-import clip counts.
3. **Builtins:** a dependency-kind table covers every document-dependent builtin documented by [XSD expressionType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:516): prop, propAtTime, markerTime, param, audioAmplitude, geo, geoVisible, and beat. Dependencies are followed transitively, including beatGrid/source. Dynamic targets are clearly refused. Cross-checked against sr-eval/src/expr/vm.rs.
4. **XML comments:** all expression text children are concatenated without comments; their combined length is charged before allocation and scanning.
5. **Ancestor constraints:** the retained-behavior table includes transformConstraint and follows its schema-declared IDREFs. A parity test checks the table against XSD nodeBehaviour, animationElements, and bodyBehaviour.

Closure remains iterative, bounded by 100,000 nodes, depth 256, and 2,000,000 work units. Repeat audio expansion remains an explicitly reported implementation limitation.

TDD evidence: [red run](/tmp/fixoverlay-round3-red.log) observed 10 failures; all pass in the final gate. Overlay test names below have prefix overlay_round3_; audio names have prefix scene_import_round3_.

| Test | Observed red failure |
|---|---|
| repeat_audio_templates_are_not_occurrences | 1 audio clip, expected 0 |
| three_d_video_audio_uses_source_clocks | 0 audio clips, expected 1 |
| three_d_audio_loop_reverse_and_remap | Empty audio instead of two reverse segments |
| beat_grid_and_source | Missing beatGrid |
| audio_amplitude_track | Missing music track |
| geo_map | Missing world map |
| geo_visible_map | Missing world map |
| dynamic_builtin_targets_refused | Dynamic target incorrectly succeeded |
| xml_comments_preserve_all_expression_text | Missing other sibling |
| ancestor_transform_constraint | Missing transformConstraint |

An intermediate round-trip assertion exposed a fixture using an opaque background with a helper documented for transparent backgrounds; the fixture was corrected. The additional schema parity test also passes.

**Final VM gate:** fmt, Clippy with -D warnings, **355 tests passed / 0 failed / 3 existing ignores**, and **51 Wasm crates passed**. [Gate log](/tmp/fixoverlay-round3-gate.log).

**Pinned corpus:** 1,343 cases; 2,020 imports, exports, and schema-oracle checks; 4,040 successful re-imports.

| Category | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| external-expression | 0 | 0 |
| generated-id | 0 | 0 |
| material-override | 0 | 0 |
| voxel-palette | 0 | 0 |
| geodesic-camera | 0 | 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 | 11 |
| linked-audio | 72 | 72 |

All 83 unrelated failure records match exactly, including case, stage, and message. The corpus command exits 101 solely for those unchanged failures. [Completed baseline](/tmp/fixoverlay-round2-corpus.log), [final corpus](/tmp/fixoverlay-round3-corpus.log).

No renderer code was borrowed this round. The earlier tokenizer adaptation from scene-render/crates/sr-model/src/program_ids.rs remains; the integrator must retain its attribution at revision 9ebe0889b946aea2bbb8156c1fa0bfbd2b405b84.

No commits, pushes, or new dependencies. Task completed; all locks released.
